question: Assume today is 2026-10-24. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the total profits of China's industrial enterprises above designated size (规模以上工业企业利润总额) for January-September 2026 (the cumulative total, not the single month of September), in Chinese yuan (CNY; the release states it in 亿元, i.e. units of 100 million yuan), as it will be first reported in the National Bureau of Statistics of China's monthly release on profits of industrial enterprises.

target.what: Cumulative total profits of industrial enterprises above designated size (规模以上工业企业利润总额) in China, January–September 2026, as first reported by NBS in its monthly profits release (stated in 亿元, i.e. 100 million CNY). Profits = total profit before income tax of industrial enterprises with annual main
target.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
target.caveats: Target period is completed relative to cutoff 2026-10-24 but the first release (typically ~27th of following month) may not yet be published at cutoff, so this is a forecast of the first print. Definitional notes: 'above designated size' is a fixed panel of enterprises meeting the revenue threshold,

candidates.hypothesis: The Jan–Sep 2026 cumulative profit is anchored on the same period in prior years plus recent YTD prints (Jan–Aug 2026, and Jan–Sep 2025). Growth rate of cumulative profits YTD is the key bridge: target = prior-year same-period level × (1 + YTD growth).
candidates.data_to_find: NBS reported cumulative 利润总额 for Jan–Sep in 2023, 2024, 2025 (in 亿元) and the Jan–Aug 2026 cumulative level and YoY growth; also monthly YoY growth prints for Jul and Aug 2026 to gauge momentum. Minimum: Jan–Sep 2025 level and Jan–Aug 2026 level/growth.

assessment.note: All report the same NBS Jan-Aug 2026 print: 52,719.8亿元, +15.7% YoY. Many are verbatim copies of the same NBS release or secondary reprints (Sina, Eastmoney, broker notes), so they are one underlying measurement, not independent confirmation. Use p3/p98 (yuan) as the level and p1 as the growth.
All report August 2026 single-month profit growth of +4.2%, down from July's +11.2% (p16/p26/p70/p112/p160). Same NBS source; the deceleration is the key momentum signal for September.

Same NBS Jan-Aug 2026 revenue (93.09万亿, +6.6%), cost (79.19万亿, +6.1%) and margin (5.66%, +0.44pp). Internally consistent: 5.66% x 93.09万亿 is about 52,720亿. p166 says +0.42pp vs +0.44pp elsewhere - minor rounding, immaterial.

NBS Jan-Sep 2025 baseline: 53,732.0亿元, +3.2%, revenue 102.08万亿, margin 5.26%. Prior-year anchor for the Jan-Sep 2026 target. September 2025 single-month was +21.6% (p9/p61), a high base that mechanically depresses September 2026 YoY.
Jan-Jul 2026: 45,820.6亿元, +17.6%, revenue 80.92万亿 (+6.5%), margin 5.66%. Consistent with the Jan-Aug print; cumulative growth decelerated from 17.6% to 15.7%.

NBS September 2026 industrial activity: value-added +5.5% (cumulative +5.3%), manufacturing +6.0%, high-tech +15.3%, export delivery value +17.0% nominal (cumulative +10.7%). Signals solid volume/export momentum in September, supporting a positive but moderating profit month.

September 2026 external sector strong: exports +29.6% (CNY) / +36.3% (USD), PPI +5.0% YoY (+1.2% MoM), imports +31%. Rising PPI and strong exports are tailwinds for September industrial profit, offsetting the high 2025 base.

PPI path: +3.5% July, +3.8% August, +5.0% September (p118). Cumulative Jan-Aug +2.0% (p168), Jan-Sep -2.3% (p117) - note p117's sign conflicts with the monthly positives; treat p117 as suspect (see decisions).
August 2026 industrial value-added +5.2%, consistent across sources; context for the August profit deceleration.
Finished-goods inventory +11.0% YoY, faster than revenue - a drag signal (working-capital/inventory build) that tempers the profit outlook.

Electronics sector profit roughly doubled (+110% Jan-Aug 2026, 8,474.7亿元 vs 4,937.7亿元 Jan-Sep 2025), contributing ~62% of overall profit growth. A key driver of the elevated 2026 growth; its persistence into September matters.
Coal mining Jan-Sep 2025 profit 2,246.4亿元 (-51.1%); with 2026 coal +51.6% (p6) this is a swing factor but small in level terms.
September 2025 single-month profit +21.6% - the high base that makes September 2026 YoY mechanically weak even with decent activity.
CITIC Q2 2026 forecast (+20.3%) and H1 sector growth figures - context on momentum, but Q2 vintage and not a September nowcast; use only as directional cross-check.
2024 Jan-Aug baseline (46,527.3亿元, +0.5%, margin 5.34%) - older-period context for the multi-year profit path; not directly used in the target bridge.

decisions.reason: States Jan-Sep 2026 cumulative PPI -2.3%, which contradicts the monthly PPI prints (+3.5% Jul, +3.8% Aug, +5.0% Sep, p118/p154/p155) and the Jan-Aug cumulative +2.0% (p168). Sign/level is internally inconsistent; unusable as a price input.

Purchase-price cumulative +3.6% is inconsistent with the same release's monthly purchase prices (+6.9% Sep) and with the PPI path; likely a sign/transcription error in the same suspect article as p117. Not needed for the profit bridge.

Real-estate investment -20.6% is a property-drag context point but is not used in any executable profit route and its magnitude is implausible relative to the rest of the release; excluded to avoid contaminating the shock narrative.
Text says consumer-goods profit 'fell 11.3%' while the value is recorded as +11.3% growth - sign ambiguity makes it unusable.
Count of A-share pre-announcements (~1,830) is irrelevant to the industrial-profit level.
Social-financing stock growth is macro context with no executable link to September industrial profit.
2024 Jan-Aug cumulative growth (+0.5%) is superseded by the 2025 and 2026 vintages for the same series; redundant older vintage.
2024 August single-month -17.8% is an old-vintage monthly print not used in any route; redundant.
2024 Jan-Aug revenue is an older vintage of a series already represented by 2025/2026 values; redundant.

methods.rationale: Bridge route (d6): Jan-Sep 2026 = observed Jan-Aug 2026 (p3) + September 2026 single-month profit, where September 2026 = September 2025 level (a2) x (1 + September YoY growth a1). Anchors on the hard Jan-Aug print and adds a September increment driven by the August momentum (+4.2%), the high 2025 base (+21.6%), and September tailwinds (PPI +5.0%, exports +29.6%, value-added +5.5%). Main failure modes: a2 is an approximation of the September 2025 month, and a1 is an assumption; both are wide.

Route d1: Jan-Sep 2026 = Jan-Sep 2025 level (p10, 53,732.0亿元) x (1 + YTD growth). Uses the prior-year same-period level and the observed Jan-Aug 2026 cumulative growth (p1, +15.7%) as the signal, with the 2025 Jan-Sep growth (p8, +3.2%) as the prior-year signal. Assumes the Jan-Sep 2026 YTD growth is close to the Jan-Aug 2026 YTD growth (15.7%), i.e. September does not sharply reverse the cumulative trend. Failure mode: September 2026 could decelerate the cumulative growth below 15.7% given the high base.

assumptions.rationale: August single-month growth was +4.2% (p2/p25), July +11.2% (p16). September 2025 base was very high (+21.6%, p9), which mechanically depresses September 2026 YoY. Offsetting tailwinds: PPI +5.0% YoY and +1.2% MoM (p118/p120), exports +29.6% (p124), value-added +5.5% (p76). Net: modest positive single-digit growth, centered near 6%, wide range reflecting base-effect and electronics-dependence uncertainty.
assumptions.applies_when: September 2026 activity/price/export signals (p76, p118, p124) persist and the electronics boom does not reverse.
assumptions.falsified_by: A September single-month print far from this range, or evidence of an electronics profit collapse or a sharp PPI reversal.

Centered near 5,373亿 with a wide range.

assumptions.falsified_by: An observed September 2025 single-month profit level outside the range.

methods.label: m1

p3.role: Cumulative total profit of industrial enterprises above designated size, China, Jan–Aug 2026, in yuan

a2.role: September 2025 single-month profit level in 亿元

methods.rationale: Bridge route: Jan–Sep 2026 = observed Jan–Aug 2026 (p3) + September 2026 single-month profit, where September = September 2025 level (a2) × (1 + growth a1). Uses the strongest observed anchor (p3) and the deceleration momentum from p2/p9. Main failure mode: a2 is derived rather than directly observed, and a1 is an assumption.
methods.error: input a1: assumption a1 was rejected (need 0 < low <= value <= high)

methods.label: m2

p10.role: Cumulative total profit of industrial enterprises above designated size, China, Jan–Sep 2025, in yuan

p1.role: YoY growth of cumulative total profits, Jan–Aug 2026 (fraction), used as the Jan–Sep 2026 growth proxy

p8.role: YoY growth of cumulative total profits, Jan–Sep 2025 (fraction), the base-period growth

methods.rationale: Prior-year same-period anchor: Jan–Sep 2025 profit (p10) scaled by the ratio of Jan–Aug 2026 growth (p1, 15.7%) to Jan–Sep 2025 growth (p8, 3.2%). Assumes the YTD growth rate carries from Jan–Aug into Jan–Sep. Failure mode: September 2025's high base (+21.6%) makes the Jan–Sep growth rate likely lower than the Jan–Aug rate, so this route may overstate.

methods.label: m3

p4.role: Cumulative operating revenue of industrial enterprises above designated size, China, Jan–Aug 2026, in yuan

methods.rationale: Revenue × margin decomposition using observed Jan–Aug 2026 values (p4, p5). This reproduces the Jan–Aug level and serves as a structural cross-check; it does not extend to September, so it is a lower-bound-ish anchor rather than a September forecast. Failure mode: ignores the September increment entirely.

methods.label: m4

p11.role: Cumulative operating revenue of industrial enterprises above designated size, China, Jan–Sep 2025, in yuan

p68.role: Year-on-year growth of cumulative main business revenue, Jan–Jul 2026 (fraction), used as the September 2026 cumulative revenue growth proxy

a3.role: September 2026 cumulative margin change vs Jan–Sep 2025 (percentage points as fraction)

methods.rationale: Independent revenue × margin route anchored on Jan–Sep 2025 (p11, p12), adjusted by the latest observed cumulative revenue growth (p68, +6.5%) and an assumed margin change (a3). Uses the PPI acceleration and value-added momentum as the basis for the revenue growth proxy, and the narrowing margin gain (p201) for a3. Failure mode: a3 is an assumption; margin change is the dominant uncertainty.
methods.error: input a3: assumption a3 restates kept data point p79 (same value and unit); reference p79 instead

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
